resources.string: Host is running — guests join via QR
Start the host on this phone
From a computer over USB: file transfer → internal storage → Music → MusicBox. After copying, tap Start or open Add in the remote so the library refreshes.
Scan the QR to open the queue
On the guest phone: Advanced → Proceed to site (local certificate).
Copy mp3 files into Music/MusicBox from a computer, then restart the host or open Add.
Port applies after you restart the host. Vote and dislike limits apply as soon as you save.
The emulator cannot run SoftAP (code 2). Connect guests to the same Wi‑Fi as the host, or try a real phone.
Turn on Wi‑Fi, then tap Hotspot again.
Turn on location — Android requires it for a local hotspot.
Permission needed: location and Nearby Wi‑Fi Devices.
Hotspot is used by the system. Turn off Android hotspot in Settings and retry, or keep the system hotspot and connect guests to it.

Local hotspot is unavailable (code 2). Turn on location and Wi‑Fi. It does not work on the emulator — use the same network as the host. On a phone you can share internet from Settings → Network → Hotspot.
No free Wi‑Fi channel for hotspot. Disable VPN/another hotspot and try again.
The system blocked tethering. Allow hotspot in settings or with your carrier.
